page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6a.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs driven by AMD EPYC 7H12 processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz. System memory totals 512.0 GB, delivering a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory proportion with 8.0 GB of RAM allocated per physical core. The hardware configuration contains no graphics processing units or hardware accelerators, providing pure x86 compute capabilities paired with substantial memory capacity.

The server operates with 16 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Local storage is not bundled with this instance type, requiring external cloud storage volumes for the operating system and application persistent data. Because storage is decoupled from the compute instance, I/O performance depends on the throughput and IOPS limits of attached network block devices rather than direct bare-metal disk buses.

By offering 512 GB of RAM across 64 dedicated cores, the ecs.r6a.16xlarge provides high resource density for workloads where memory footprint dominates execution requirements. It is suited for in-memory databases, large-scale Redis or Memcached clusters, enterprise ERP platforms, distributed analytics, and large batch ETL pipelines that load extensive datasets entirely into system RAM.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6a.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance engineered for workloads demanding substantial random-access memory capacity. Driven by the KVM hypervisor, it provides 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs utilizing AMD EPYC 7H12 processors clocked at 2.6 GHz. The hardware configuration couples these dedicated compute cores with 512.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance does not bundle local disk storage, necessitating network-attached block storage for persistence, and it contains no discrete hardware accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Network connectivity is supported at a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth. With its dense memory configuration and dedicated processor allocation, the ecs.r6a.16xlarge is positioned for high-capacity in-memory databases, distributed caches, big data processing engines, and large enterprise application backends requiring high memory footprints.
